statements.subject: session
statements.description: The DESCRIBE reply-response pair constitutes the media initialization phase of RTSP.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The DESCRIBE reply-response pair constitutes the media initialization phase of RTSP. The server MUST respond with a description of the requested resource and return the description in the message body of the response, if the DESCRIBE method request can be successfully fulfilled.
actions: server returns description in message body

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If a client obtains a valid description from an alternate source, the client MAY use this description for initialization purposes without issuing a DESCRIBE request for the same media.
statements.trigger: valid description obtained from alternate source
actions: client uses alternate description for initialization without issuing DESCRIBE request
